title: Sub-Regional Medical Lead
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Global Medical & Health (GMH) team is seeking a licensed physician to serve as Sub-Regional Medical Lead (SRML) for a geographic cluster of approximately to 10 Amazon sites in Mexico. This role is the designated clinical authority and Sanitary Officer —in accordance with the General Health Law and its applicable regulations— for all occupational medical services within the assigned sub-region, providing physician-level supervision of On-Site Medical Representatives (OMR)—Licensed Nurses and Nursing Technicians—and ensuring compliance with Mexican federal health and labor regulations.

The SRML addresses a critical regulatory gap: the Federal Labor Law (Article 504), NOM-019-SSA3-2013, and COFEPRIS requirements mandate continuous physician-led clinical supervision at each site. This role directly fulfills that obligation, serving as the authorized signatory for Operational Notices, nursing supervision per NOM-019-SSA3-2013, and all COFEPRIS regulatory documentation within the assigned zone.

You will work with the Regional Medical Lead to implement evidence-based health programs and standardize clinical protocols. You will supervise OMR teams and drive improvements in associate health outcomes and regulatory compliance posture.
They will assist with the implementation of programs at the site level, reporting directly to the Regional Medical Lead.


Key job responsibilities
As the Regional Occupational Health Physician, you will serve as the designated Sanitary Officer and clinical authority for all sites within your assigned sub-region. Your core responsibilities include:

Regulatory Compliance: Serve as the designated Sanitary Officer under the General Health Law and COFEPRIS requirements. Sign and maintain Operational Notices and regulatory documentation, ensure compliance with applicable NOMs and labor/health laws, conduct compliance audits, attend regulatory inspections, and safeguard clinical records and personal data.

Clinical Supervision of OMR Operations: Provide direct physician supervision (NOM-019-SSA3-2013) to nursing staff in AMCARE spaces, act as the clinical authority for diagnoses, restrictions, and prescriptions, oversee daily OMR activities, and review Return-to-Work plans, fitness-for-duty determinations, and workplace accident management.

Medication Governance: Establish a formal medication approval process aligned with COFEPRIS, standardize formularies across the sub-region, approve clinical protocols for medication administration, and audit medication and controlled-substance records.

Epidemiological Surveillance & Prevention: Execute occupational surveillance programs, implement prevention campaigns based on regional data, lead vaccination and early-detection drives, and support heat-stress and exposure-control strategies in coordination with WHS.

Medical Surveillance & Occupational Health Exams: Support surveillance programs (NOM-030-STPS-2009 / RFSST), periodic health exams, pre-employment and fitness-for-duty assessments, biological monitoring, and PPE compliance, while ensuring medical record confidentiality.

OMR Team Development: Mentor and train OMR staff, standardize clinical protocols and documentation across the sub-region, and ensure competency in emergency equipment, inventory management, and Safety and Hygiene Committee participation.

Strategic Leadership: Participate in Monthly Business Reviews, collaborate with WHS, PXT, Operations, and Legal, support the Regional Medical Lead's national agenda, and drive improvements in associate health outcomes and attrition mitigation.

This role requires regular travel (60–80%) within the assigned sub-region of Mexico.

A day in the life
No two days look exactly alike in this role, but here's a glimpse of what yours might involve:

You start your morning reviewing overnight incident reports and care statistics across the sites in your sub-region. A workplace injury was logged at one location last night, so you connect with the OMR nurse on site to review the initial care documentation, confirm the ST-7 was properly managed, and begin coordinating a Return-to-Work plan that aligns the associate's medical restrictions with available job functions.

Mid-morning, you travel to one of your assigned sites for a scheduled compliance audit. Walking the AMCARE space, you verify that the infrastructure and equipment meet NOM-005-SSA3-2018 requirements, review clinical records for traceability and retention compliance, and spot-check medication logs and controlled-substance documentation. You identify a minor deviation in the formulary and work with the nursing staff on a corrective action plan on the spot.

Over lunch, you join a remote Monthly Business Review, presenting your sub-region's health metrics, injury/illness trends, and compliance status to leadership — and flagging an emerging musculoskeletal trend that you recommend addressing with a targeted ergonomics prevention campaign.

In the afternoon, you provide clinical supervision and mentorship to the OMR team: reviewing a complex fitness-for-duty case that exceeds their scope, validating a medical clearance for work at heights, and running a short teaching session on NOM-035 mental health screening and referral pathways. You close the day collaborating with WHS and PXT colleagues on a heat-stress mitigation strategy for the upcoming season, and reviewing a Privacy Notice update to ensure associate health data stays protected.

Throughout it all, you are the clinical and regulatory anchor for your region — balancing hands-on physician leadership with the strategic, preventive, and compliance work that keeps associates healthy and sites compliant.

About the team
Inclusive team culture
 
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.  
 
Work Life Balance
 
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.  
 
Mentorship & Career Growth
 
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working to appropriate health & safety standards and regulations
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- - Medical degree from a Mexican institution recognized by the Ministry of Public Education (SEP)
- - Valid Professional License issued by the General Directorate of Professions
- - Specialty or postgraduate training in Occupational Medicine, Epidemiology, or Public Health
- - Legally authorized to sign regulatory filings and assume personal legal responsibility for health operations across multiple sites
- - Minimum 2 years of occupational health experience.
- - Experience providing physician supervision of nursing staff in a clinical or occupational health setting
- - Willingness to travel 60–80% within Mexico

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in operations management
- - Prior experience as COFEPRIS Sanitary Officer
- - Experience with IMSS regulatory processes including workplace accident reporting and ST form management
- - Knowledge of the Regulation of the General Health Law on Medical Care Services and NOM-005-SSA3-2018 (infrastructure and equipment for ambulatory care facilities)
- - Experience supporting occupational epidemiological surveillance programs
- - Experience with clinical auditing, quality assurance, and continuous improvement methodologies

The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators

-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends

Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily

· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. title: Propulsion Lab Engineer, Amazon Leo GNC & Propulsion
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

The Propulsion Lab Engineer will be a key member of Amazon Leo's Propulsion Manufacturing team, combining deep technical expertise with strong collaborative skills. This role will lead the development and optimization of electric propulsion manufacturing infrastructure while working across engineering disciplines. The ideal candidate will drive technical solutions for manufacturing challenges, implement process controls, and maintain critical lab equipment, while effectively partnering with Design, Quality, Systems, and Test engineers to translate requirements into robust manufacturing processes. Success in this role requires both hands-on technical leadership and the ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration to achieve manufacturing excellence.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Build or Test development and production hardware in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, and engineering drawings, including component and subsystem fabrication (machining, 3D printing, rapid prototyping).
• Conduct detailed inspections and testing of production and reworked hardware to validate functionality, performance, and conformance to specifications.
• Navigate MES/SAP systems in support of production operations.
• Execute failure analysis and root cause investigations on non-conforming propulsion hardware.
• Execute hardware rework tasks as needed.
• Work with Responsible Engineers and Mfg. Engineers to diagnose and solve issues resulting in yield and throughput improvements.
• Identify and/or lead process improvement initiatives to increase rework efficiency, reduce scrap rates, maintain 5S standards and improve first-pass yield.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve integration challenges, validate rework procedures, provide design-for-manufacturability feedback, and implement corrective actions.
• Support the development and improvement of assembly and test procedures based on hands-on build experience and design-for-manufacturability feedback.
• Take loosely defined requests from engineers, clarify requirements, and develop a concrete plan of lab work owned through completion.
• Prioritize and manage a personal work queue against team goals, sequence builds and tests to prevent blockers and keep multiple efforts moving concurrently with limited supervision.
• Coordinate task execution within assigned work streams, track progress, and flag schedule or resource risks.
• Support and maintain Test and/or Mfg. team tool program for development and production stations.
• Collaborate with Amazon Leo facility team and support preventative maintenance for development and production test chambers.
• Support with Propulsion lab organization and floor space layout.
• Operate shop tools and lab equipment effectively and safely.
• Train and mentor team members on rework techniques, lab systems, tools, safety protocols, and quality standards.
• Document technical issues, rework procedures, resolutions, and lessons learned.
• Track and report on rework metrics including cycle time, yield rates, defect trends, and scrap reduction.


A day in the life
The Propulsion Lab Engineer will perform a variety of tasks involving support for both Mfg. and Test infrastructure and executing on these actions. Lab Engineers will work closely with both Technicians and Manufacturing/Responsible Engineers to identify process improvements to improve both Mfg. and Test efficiency and optimization. The Lab Engineer will actively monitor Mfg./Test infrastructure, equipment health, station status, and process performance with the intent to proactively identify and action issues that could impact the efficiency, throughput, and/or overall health of the department before they escalate into production blockers.

A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced production environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment for quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.


About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team is responsible for the design, development, and testing of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

Basic qualifications

- Experience planning and maintaining lab facilities for optimal efficiency and creating new processes when necessary
- • Associate’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent experience in a related STEM field.
- • 4+ years of experience in the assembly, integration, calibration, and test of aerospace hardware in a development or production environment.
- • Experience executing qualification test campaigns for aerospace or defense hardware.
- • Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems, and systems.
- • Experience with hardware rework, assembly/disassembly, or precision manufacturing operations.
- • Experience with precision torque, measurement, and inspection devices (e.g., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters).
- • Experience planning and maintaining lab facilities for optimal efficiency, including managing lab resources, equipment, and supplies.
- • Experience tracking and coordinating lab tasks across concurrent activities using ticketing or project management tools.
- • Experience contributing to and developing engineering documentation, procedures, and SOPs for complex working processes.
- • Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred qualifications

- • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent STEM field.
- • Experience working with vacuum and/or pressurized gas systems.
- • Experience with test execution software such as Test Stand, LabVIEW, and Python.
- • Experience with testing of production hardware designed for space environments.
- • Experience building, commissioning, and maintaining test racks and testing infrastructure.
- • Experience with tube fabrication and orbital tube welding (OTW).
- • Experience scheduling and delivering high-impact test and Mfg. infrastructure scope.
- • Experience working with FOD, ESD-sensitive hardware, and cleanroom requirements, including contamination control protocols.
- • 2+ years of experience contributing to or owning a calibration and equipment tracking system.
- • Experience supporting automated test sequences or system characterization routines.
- • Background in continuous improvement frameworks (Six Sigma, Lean, 5S).
- • Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, macros, SQL, and visualization tools (Tableau, Quick, Grafana).
- • Experience running user trials, beta testing, field testing, or collecting customer feedback.
- • Experience working with hardware and software teams for setting up, testing, and troubleshooting prototype devices.
- • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to document technical findings clearly.

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, supplier economics, and the broader travel ecosystem. This individual is responsible for defining the commercial terms, cost structures, and contractual frameworks through which employees access travel inventory across channels. This role also interfaces across Amazon business units, partnering with AWS, Advertising, and Operations teams to ensure commercial agreements and distribution strategies reflect the full breadth of Amazon's supplier relationships and leverage our collective scale.

This is a buyer-side role with a seller-side vocabulary: the ideal candidate understands GDS economics, NDC content flows, agency models, and rate parity structures, and uses that knowledge to negotiate from strength, optimize distribution costs, and ensure Amazon's program captures maximum value from every supplier relationship. The travel industry is undergoing a structural transformation as NDC and direct distribution reshape content access and legacy intermediary models evolve. This role develops the distribution and commercial strategy that positions Amazon to lead through that transformation.


Key job responsibilities
Commercial Strategy & Distribution Economics
- Own the commercial strategy for how distribution agreements are structured across TMCs, OBTs, GDS providers, and content aggregators — defining the contractual frameworks that govern transaction fees, incentive structures, content access terms, and commercial economics across channels
- Define commercial term segmentation by channel type, supplier tier, and category, ensuring terms are tailored to the economic profile and strategic value of each distribution relationship
- Design and manage the portfolio of supplier relationships that drive the content into our booking channels across distribution solutions
- Define channel segmentation by travel type (air, hotel, ground) and traveler population, and set adoption targets by channel based on cost, compliance, and traveler experience
- Own channel-level cost of distribution: transaction fees, GDS segment costs, OBT licensing, TMC service fees, and technology overhead
- Model total cost of acquisition by channel, incorporating direct costs, compliance rates, policy savings, and traveler productivity impact
- Ensure distribution agreements complement — not conflict with — supplier-direct negotiated rates, allotment commitments, and exclusivity terms
- Manage contract lifecycle: renewals, amendments, SLA enforcement, and performance-based renegotiation triggers for distribution suppliers
- Monitor channel leakage and develop strategies to drive bookings toward preferred managed channels
- Evaluate emerging distribution models (NDC-native aggregators, direct-connect platforms, AI-powered booking interfaces) for fit within the AT&E ecosystem
- Develop the annual distribution budget and forecast; present channel economics to AT&E leadership

Content, Data & Accreditation
- Partner with Tech & Data Solutions (T&DS) team to integrate connecting Amazon's inventory and booking systems to distribution channels via APIs, NDC, GDS, and XML feeds
- Ensure negotiated rates, corporate fares, and preferred supplier content load correctly across all distribution channels monitor content load accuracy and troubleshoot gaps
- Partner with T&DS on the connectivity roadmap: NDC adoption, GDS optimization, direct-connect buildout, and data pipeline architecture
- Partner with TD&S to ensure booking data flows back from all channels for spend visibility, policy compliance reporting, duty-of-care tracking, and travel risk management
- Evaluate and manage content aggregation strategy (ATPCO, third-party content sources) to maximize fare and rate coverage
- Develop a holistic understanding of travel ecosystem economics — how distribution channels, payment mechanisms, accreditation models, and supplier agreements interconnect, and where Amazon can unlock value by operating differently
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Compliance to understand accreditation requirements, costs, and benefits across jurisdictions

Pan-Amazon Commercial Development
- Support quarterly pan-Amazon strategy sessions with AWS, AB, Ads, and Operations, particularly where distribution and commercial decisions intersect with BU-specific supplier economics
- Identify cross-Amazon synergies where enterprise-wide supplier relationships create leverage for both content and distribution strategy as well as our business partners (AWS, Ads, etc)
- Align with Supplier Strategy to ensure distribution terms and channel architecture reinforce — rather than undercut — category-level supplier negotiations
- Represent distribution and commercial strategy in AT&E leadership planning, vendor QBRs, and cross-functional program reviews

Basic qualifications

- Experience communicating effectively with senior leadership
- 5+ years of progressive experience in travel distribution, corporate travel program management, TMC/OBT operations, or travel technology
- Deep understanding of travel distribution economics — GDS, NDC, direct connects, content aggregation models, and the cost structures of intermediary layers
- Demonstrated track record negotiating distribution agreements with GDS providers, TMCs, OBTs, or content aggregators
- Strong analytical skills — comfortable building and interpreting channel performance models, cost analyses, and business cases

Preferred qualifications

- Existing relationships with major GDS providers, TMCs, OBTs, or content aggregators
- Hands-on NDC implementation or migration experience (airline or corporate buyer side)
- Experience evaluating or managing agency accreditation processes and their commercial implications
- Revenue management or pricing background that informs channel-specific rate strategy
- Experience at a large-scale corporate travel program (Fortune 100 or equivalent volume)
- Understanding of centralized payment mechanisms (virtual cards, lodge cards, ARC/BSP settlement)
- Familiarity with duty-of-care data requirements, travel risk management, and how distribution architecture supports both
- Knowledge of Spotnana, BCD, Concur, or similar corporate travel platforms
- MBA or advanced degree preferred but not required
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Business, or a related field
- Direct ownership of channel-level P&L or distribution cost management
- Experience operating at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical connectivity
- Familiarity with agency accreditation frameworks (ARC, IATA, BSP) and how they relate to distribution economics

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. Amazon Leo is seeking a Manufacturing Tooling & Test Equipment Design Engineer to design, develop, and deploy manufacturing tools, test fixtures, and specialized equipment supporting the development, qualification, and production of satellite battery systems and electronic assemblies.

This role owns the end-to-end development of mechanical tooling and test equipment for PCBA, battery pack, and component-level assembly and testing. The engineer will translate engineering and manufacturing requirements into robust, repeatable, and scalable solutions that improve production throughput, quality, safety, and operational efficiency. - Hands-on experience with mechanical fabrication, machining, assembly, prototyping, and equipment troubleshooting.

title: Software Development Engineer, AI Foundations, Amazon Leo Networking Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's Low Earth Orbit satellite network, built to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. The AI Foundations team builds AI agents that turn Leo's best troubleshooting expertise into diagnoses in minutes instead of hours, helping keep the network available for every customer.

As a Software Development Engineer on AI Foundations, you will design and build production agentic systems on AWS that reason over real satellite, ground, and network data. You will work directly with principal engineers and network operators, and your work will shape how Leo is operated at scale.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate AI agents and services that diagnose network and connectivity issues using telemetry, logs, and engineering knowledge.
- Turn proven engineering tools and data sources into reusable agent tools so teams across Leo can build on them.
- Build evaluation harnesses that measure agent accuracy, coverage, and latency, and use them to gate launches.
- Own your services in production: on-call, operational metrics, root-cause analysis, and security reviews.
- Partner with principal engineers, operators, and program managers to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features.
- Write clear design docs, give thoughtful code reviews, and help teammates adopt agentic development practices.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing overnight evaluation results and spotting a class of network failures your agent misdiagnosed. You trace the gap to a missing data source, then sit down with the principal engineer who owns that subsystem to agree on how to expose their tool to the agent. After lunch you build the integration and add new test cases, then review a teammate's pull request. Late afternoon, you join an operations review where an operator walks through a real incident your agent helped resolve, and you leave with a clear next priority.

About the team
AI Foundations is a new team in Amazon Leo's networking software organization. Our mission is to help Leo reach and sustain its network availability goals by turning the organization's best troubleshooting expertise into AI agents anyone can use. We build the shared foundations (agent tooling, evaluation, and integrations) that let engineering and operations teams across Leo ship their own agents safely. Because the team is early, you will help shape its architecture, engineering bar, and culture. We value builders who are curious about how satellite networks work, measure what they ship, and prefer simple systems that operators trust.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Technicien/ne Sécurité au Travail
descriptionHtml:
Assurer la sécurité et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs au travail est une priorité absolue chez Amazon. Nos Techniciens de Sécurité jouent un rôle essentiel dans ce domaine. Ce poste est l'occasion de débuter votre carrière dans la sécurité au travail et de vous développer au sein d'une entreprise internationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos experts pour surveiller votre site, ce qui vous permettra de constater chaque jour l'impact de votre travail sur le bien-être de chacun.

Key job responsibilities
- Effectuer des évaluations de risques et des audits
- Surveiller le site pour s'assurer que les processus sont conformes aux procédures de sécurité d'Amazon
- Créer et mettre à jour des rapports sur les indicateurs de sécurité pour vos collègues
- Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles et d'autres services sur des tâches liées à la sécurité et offrir des conseils sur les processus
- Soutenir la mise en place de nouvelles mesures de sécurité

A day in the life
Vous travaillerez sur l'un de nos sites. Cela signifie que vous pourrez suivre de près ce qui se passe et que les collaborateurs pourront facilement vous poser des questions pendant leurs postes. Ce rôle consiste avant tout à repérer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent. Vous passerez beaucoup de temps à vérifier le site et à comprendre comment les collaborateurs utilisent les équipements. En comprenant le fonctionnement de chaque tâche et de chaque machine, vous serez en mesure de trouver la meilleure façon de garantir la sécurité des processus. Vous serez également l'une des personnes chargées de mettre en œuvre les changements en matière de sécurité, ce qui signifie que vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreuses personnes. En plus de vos tâches quotidiennes et hebdomadaires, vous apporterez votre soutien à notre équipe Operations sur des missions ponctuelles liées à la sécurité.

About the team
L'équipe Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) joue un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bien-être mental et physique de nos collaborateurs au travail. Notre équipe travaille avec les responsables, les associés et les administrations locales sur l'ensemble de nos sites, en assurant le respect des politiques d'Amazon et des réglementations légales, et en garantissant la sécurité de nos environnements de travail. L'équipe offre une variété d'opportunités, des Techniciens de Sécurité aux Responsables de Programmes.

Basic qualifications

- DUT HSE (Hygiène, Sécurité, Environnement) ou BUT (Licence) en HSE
- Expérience pertinente dans l'utilisation de l'analyse de données pour générer et expliquer des indicateurs
- Connaissance de la législation française en matière de santé et sécurité au travail

Preferred qualifications

- Maîtrise du français et connaissances de base en anglais (A2), à l'écrit et à l'oral
- Expérience avec les méthodologies Lean, 5S ou Kaizen
- Expérience dans la planification ou la gestion d'initiatives écoresponsables
- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Manager, Conversation Design, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Want to help people at an extraordinary scale? Amazon Customer Service is seeking a hands-on team manager to lead the critical Conversation Design function. Our mission is to make customer service interactions so good they become a primary reason customers choose Amazon. When our customers need help, we make solutions effortless. We innovate relentlessly, spending time with customer service associates, with customers in the field, in the UX research lab, and iterating on UX prototypes. Our work greatly impacts our customers' experience and is critical for Amazon.

In this role you will lead a team to define voice, tone, and language guidelines that shape how Amazon communicates with customers — creating conversational specifications, writing prompts, authoring evaluation guidelines, and annotating data to identify patterns in model behavior. You will be critical to providing high quality conversational interfaces across voice and text platforms, defining the strategic, building scalable documentation and governance frameworks, and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Applied Science teams to develop AI agents. This leader will be responsible for delivering measurable customer experience results, ensuring consistent and high quality voice and tone across Customer Service touchpoints.

- Leads with deep empathy for our customers, our customer service associates, and team members.
- Ensures creative quality through the methods and mechanisms set in motion.
- Invested in growing people, developing talent, creating an inclusive and inspiring environment, and fostering collaboration.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Quick Business Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) QuickSight is looking to hire an experienced Software Development Engineer to support the fast growing organization that builds world class experiences and services for our customers. AWS QuickSight is a fast, easy-to-use, cloud-based, serverless Business Intelligence (BI) service designed for easy deployment to tens of thousands of users. As a fully-managed SaaS application, there's no need to buy, manage, and scale servers and no software to deploy and upgrade. QuickSight is deeply integrated with AWS data sources, allowing companies to deploy secure and scalable BI on their data in AWS.

You will be part of a QuickSight team to grow its business intelligence platform. The team is innovating the next generation of business intelligence, leveraging agentic AI to reinvent how customers explore, analyze, visualize, and act on their data through a unified, serverless BI experience. We have just started on this journey and have a lot of autonomy in delivering the future of cloud-based business intelligence. You'll have the opportunity to influence decisions related to system architecture, feature development, and product strategy, and to design and build complex distributed systems with AWS Serverless and microservice architecture. The team has plenty of opportunities to learn from the best in the industry and grow your career, since this is a high visibility and strategic project.

Our next journey is agentic AI. We are building and delivering the foundational AI services that let customers transform their businesses and harness the potential of AI to solve their most complex challenges, bringing agentic experiences to the way they explore and act on their data. You'll work alongside a dynamic team of AI/ML practitioners, applied scientists, software engineers, and solution architects who work backwards from customer needs to create innovative technologies. If you're passionate about shaping the future of AI while making a meaningful impact for customers worldwide, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Help define the system architecture and technical direction for our business intelligence platform, owning and implementing significant components end to end while shaping the broader connectivity and integration roadmap.
- Design and build complex, scalable distributed systems using AWS Serverless and microservice architecture, making decisions that impact the platform's long-term vision.
- Drive work across the full software lifecycle, planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and continuous process improvement, as a member of an autonomous, high-ownership team.
- Take responsibility for technical problem-solving, creatively meeting product goals under ambiguity and balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
- Define, document, and champion engineering best practices, raising the bar for code quality, operational excellence, and team-wide technical standards.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and fellow engineers to translate customer needs into differentiated capabilities, including the agentic AI experiences that define the next generation of BI.
- Mentor and elevate other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical guidance, multiplying the impact of the team.


A day in the life
A typical day mixes focused building with close collaboration. You might begin at a design review, working through an architecture proposal with fellow engineers, then sit with product managers and UX designers to shape how a new capability should look and behave for customers. From there you move into planning and designing your own components, then building and testing them, from the query and semantic layer through visualization and the agentic AI experiences that let customers explore their data conversationally. Because you own what you build, you also monitor your services in production, investigate issues, and keep improving how the platform scales to tens of thousands of users worldwide.

About the team
We are the team building the next generation of QuickSight's business intelligence platform. Our mission is to reinvent how customers explore, analyze, visualize, and act on their data, moving beyond dashboards toward a unified, serverless, agentic BI experience. We are early in this journey, so the work is high-ownership and high-impact. We work backwards from customer needs, care deeply about technical excellence, and give every engineer room to grow. We value work-life harmony. Success at work should never come at the expense of home, which is why flexibility is part of our culture.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Master's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference

title: Gestionnaire de programme technique, Infrastructure — AWS/AWS Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure, CAN
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Data Services Canada, Inc. a un poste à combler immédiatement pour un gestionnaire de programme technique (Technical Program Manager, TPM) chargé de soutenir l'expansion de l'infrastructure de livraison de capacité au Canada. AWS Infrastructure Services assure la conception, la planification, la livraison et l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale et des centres de données d'AWS. Autrement dit, nous sommes ceux qui font fonctionner l'infonuagique en fournissant les serveurs, le stockage, le réseautage, l'alimentation électrique et l'équipement de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu à l'innovation sur laquelle ils comptent. Nous nous attaquons aux problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables qui influent sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'infrastructure — et nous sommes à la recherche de personnes talentueuses qui souhaitent y contribuer. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe régionale diversifiée de 15 à 20 autres TPM, principalement situés dans le Nord-Ouest du Pacifique, travaillant dans des régions de tailles variées à travers les Amériques, au sein d'une organisation plus vaste comprenant des ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, des spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des experts en sécurité, des gestionnaires des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme. Vous travaillerez avec un haut degré d'autonomie, tout en partageant les leçons apprises et en favorisant la cohérence dans l'ensemble de la région. Le TPM agira à titre de responsable unique (single-threaded owner) de la livraison de capacité dans les grappes de centres de données qui lui sont attribuées, en coordonnant des équipes interfonctionnelles de la conception jusqu'au déploiement. La gestion de l'échéancier et des parties prenantes englobera des équipes disparates, notamment la planification, la conception, les finances, l'immobilier, l'énergie, la construction, la mise en service, les contrôles et autres. L'objectif principal de ce rôle est de collaborer à l'échelle de l'organisation afin de garantir que la livraison de capacité répond aux besoins de l'entreprise, voire les dépasse, tout en communiquant et en atténuant les risques. La personne idéale sera une communicatrice exceptionnellement solide, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral, et possédera au moins 3 ans d'expérience en gestion tactique de projets d'initiatives hautement techniques, ainsi qu'en gestion stratégique de programmes. Une expérience de la gestion de déploiements d'infrastructure de centres de données constitue un atout. Un baccalauréat ou une expérience technique additionnelle est exigé. Les candidats possédant une formation en architecture/conception, en génie mécanique/électrique, en génie logiciel/matériel, en infrastructure/exploitation de centres de données et/ou en construction, qui ont fait la transition vers une discipline de gestion de programme, bénéficieront d'un avantage certain. La personne candidate doit être à l'aise de gérer des équipes de livraison de projet à distance et posséder la capacité d'animer des séances techniques de type « whiteboard » pour résoudre les problèmes de mise en œuvre des projets et éliminer les obstacles à leur réussite. Il est essentiel de savoir mettre sur pied des équipes interfonctionnelles, d'établir un climat de confiance avec diverses parties prenantes réparties sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires, de gérer des budgets d'immobilisations, d'éliminer les activités sans valeur ajoutée, de concevoir des solutions, de lever les obstacles et de trouver des moyens créatifs d'accélérer la livraison des projets. Le TPM maîtrisera parfaitement une variété d'outils, de méthodologies et de techniques de gestion de projet pour toutes les phases du cycle de vie du projet, et fera preuve d'une compétence démontrée dans les disciplines fondamentales de la gestion de projet, notamment la gestion de la portée, de l'échéancier, du budget, des ressources, de la qualité et des risques, ainsi que la production de rapports et l'élaboration et le suivi des indicateurs. Les autres exigences comprennent la maîtrise de MS Office, MS Project et MS SharePoint. Une expérience de Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL et de l'intégration de systèmes constitue un atout. Ce poste exige des déplacements à hauteur de 25 % (voyages nationaux et internationaux vers les grappes de centres de données d'AWS). Si vous répondez à ces qualifications, débordez de passion et aimez les défis liés au déploiement de projets hautement techniques et innovants à très grande échelle, cet emploi est pour vous!

Amazon Data Services Canada, Inc. has an immediate opening for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) supporting capacity delivery infrastructure expansion in Canada. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure and data centers. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running by providing servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the infrastructure supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse regional team of 15-20 other TPMs, mostly located in the Pacific Northwest, working in various sized regions across the Americas, within a broader organization including software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy while sharing lessons learned and driving consistency across the region. The TPM will serve as the single-threaded owner for capacity delivery in assigned data center clusters, coordinating cross-functional teams from inception through deployment. Schedule and stakeholder management will include disparate teams including planning, design, finance, real estate, energy, construction, commissioning, controls, and others. The primary objective of this role is to work across the organization to ensure capacity delivery meets or exceeds business needs, while communicating and mitigating risks. The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess 3+ years of experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. A Bachelor's Degree or additional technical experience is required. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage. Candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must. The TPM will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include proficiency with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL and systems integration a plus. This position requires 25% Travel (Domestic and International trips to AWS Data Center Clusters). If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!

Key job responsibilities
• Assumer la responsabilité globale de l'échéancier, de la portée et de la gestion des risques des programmes de livraison de capacité d'infrastructure dans les grappes de centres de données attribuées, en prenant des décisions nettes et en levant les obstacles afin de maintenir les projets sur la bonne voie.
• Coordonner des équipes interfonctionnelles — notamment la planification, la conception, la construction, la mise en service et les contrôles — afin de livrer des constructions d'infrastructure qui peuvent nécessiter une modification des gabarits définis pour atteindre les objectifs du programme.
• Communiquer clairement et de façon concise l'état d'avancement, les risques et les compromis du programme aux parties prenantes de tous les niveaux, en veillant à ce que les bonnes personnes participent à la conversation et que les décisions soient bien éclairées.
• Repérer et atténuer tôt les risques de livraison en analysant les interdépendances entre les systèmes en amont et en aval, et faire remonter l'information de manière appropriée lorsque les constructions proposées sont trop complexes ou présentent un risque élevé.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en appliquant des méthodologies d'amélioration des processus, en définissant des indicateurs de réussite et en intégrant des pratiques d'excellence opérationnelle aux plans de programme.

• Own the overall schedule, scope, and risk management for infrastructure capacity delivery programs across assigned data center clusters, driving crisp decisions and clearing blockers to keep projects on track.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams — including planning, design, construction, commissioning, and controls — to deliver infrastructure builds that may require modification from defined templates to meet program goals.
• Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring the right people are part of the conversation and that decisions are well-informed.
• Identify and mitigate delivery risks early by analyzing interdependencies across upstream and downstream systems, escalating appropriately when proposed builds are too complex or carry elevated risk.
• Drive continuous improvement by applying process improvement methodologies, defining success metrics, and incorporating operational excellence practices into program plans.

A day in the life
Vous commencez votre matinée en passant en revue les tableaux de bord de livraison de capacité et en triant les problèmes survenus durant la nuit et signalés par les équipes partenaires. En milieu de matinée, vous dirigez une réunion debout (stand-up) interfonctionnelle avec les responsables de la conception, de la construction et de la mise en service afin de vous aligner sur les jalons et de régler les points en suspens. Après le dîner, vous pourriez animer une séance technique de type « whiteboard » pour résoudre un défi de mise en œuvre, puis passer à la mise à jour de votre registre des risques et à la préparation d'un compte rendu de situation pour la direction. Tout au long de la journée, vous échangez avec des parties prenantes réparties sur différents fuseaux horaires, en conciliant la résolution tactique de problèmes et la planification stratégique afin de faire progresser vos programmes.

You start your morning reviewing capacity delivery dashboards and triaging any overnight issues flagged by partner teams. By mid-morning you are leading a cross-functional stand-up with design, construction, and commissioning leads to align on milestones and resolve open items. After lunch you might facilitate a technical whiteboard session to troubleshoot an implementation challenge, then shift to updating your risk register and preparing a status narrative for leadership. Throughout the day you connect with stakeholders across time zones, balancing tactical problem-solving with strategic planning to keep your programs moving forward.

About the team
Notre équipe fait partie d'AWS Infrastructure Services, l'organisation responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. Nous faisons fonctionner l'infonuagique en veillant à ce que les serveurs, le stockage, le réseautage, l'alimentation électrique et l'équipement de refroidissement soient en place afin que les clients aient un accès continu aux services dont ils dépendent. Avec des milliers de variables qui influent sur la chaîne d'approvisionnement de l'infrastructure, nous nous attaquons à certains des problèmes de logistique et d'ingénierie les plus complexes chez Amazon. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe régionale inclusive de gestionnaires de programme travaillant à travers les Amériques, soutenue par des ingénieurs matériels et réseau, des spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des experts en sécurité et des gestionnaires des opérations. Nous valorisons les idées audacieuses et vous donnons l'autonomie nécessaire pour les mener à terme, tout en partageant les leçons apprises dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe diversifiée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'experts en sécurité, de gestionnaires des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes de partout chez AWS pour nous aider à offrir les normes les plus élevées en matière de sûreté et de sécurité, tout en fournissant une capacité pratiquement illimitée au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Et vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme.

title: Software Development Engineer, Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR)
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of customers? As a Software Development Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and deliver features across the full software development lifecycle. You will tackle complex technical challenges, contribute high-quality code, and collaborate with talented engineers to create solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and extensible. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, mentor fellow engineers, and continuously grow your technical skills in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions that enable new features and improvements, working across the full development lifecycle from product definition and scoping through deployment and maintenance.
- Write high-quality, well-documented code and actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates and using the review process as a coaching opportunity.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners including product managers, stakeholders, and peer engineers to understand business and customer needs, translating them into effective technical solutions.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, driving permanent fixes and continuously improving your team's operational health and technical processes.
- Evaluate and integrate generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate, applying responsible practices to augment productivity and solution quality.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing the latest deployment metrics and operational dashboards, then move into design discussions or code reviews with your teammates. You might spend the afternoon implementing a new feature, writing tests, or pairing with a colleague to debug a tricky issue. Along the way, you will document your designs and share knowledge with newer team members, helping them ramp up on the systems you maintain.

About the team
Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) is the team that makes that possible. We prevent, predict, detect, and remediate network impairments before they reach customers. Our systems ingest trillions of telemetry data points daily from millions of network devices, apply advanced streaming analytics and ML/AI to surface actionable signals, and drive automated mitigation through our event management platform. Today, over 98% of detected issues are resolved without human intervention. For the remainder, we provide expert diagnostic tooling that enables operators to act decisively. Our vision: every network failure is pre-emptively resolved by autonomous systems — zero customer impact, zero human intervention.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities

- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

title: Lab Test Engineer, Environmental Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Lab Test Engineer role is responsible for keeping aerospace environmental test production running smoothly. You will troubleshoot issues that technicians encounter during daily testing, resolving problems with test setup, equipment, and IT infrastructure. The Lab Test Engineer will be an expert for our various Automated Test Equipment (Test Racks) used during environmental testing. With your expertise in environmental testing procedures, equipment, and basic Python scripting, you will identify root causes and implement corrective actions to maximize productivity and product quality. Additionally, you are responsible for production support activities including ticket management, change management, monitoring, metrics, documentation, process development, host provisioning, and hardware management. You may also debug, evaluate, and resolve software issues for applications and services that will improve availability and performance. You will develop scripts and applications to automate redundant tasks and to improve operational efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with Development, QA, and other Support teams to maintain and improve availability and performance of Amazon LEO's production Automated Test Equipment.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintain, troubleshoot and improve test automation hardware supporting production testing
- Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical or software problems on the fly, working with an integrated cross-functional team of manufacturing engineers, test engineers, lab technicians and maintenance teams to resolve
- Perform RCCA of issues in production testing and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence
- Develop and maintain calibration procedures for RF test equipment
- Define and implement solutions to optimize and automate environmental testing
- Work with other engineers to refine test requirements and the methodologies to achieve those requirements
- Willing to “roll up sleeves and do what needs to be done” in a small, specialized, team environment
- Must be willing to work off shifts and weekends as required



A day in the life
The primary goal of this role is to ensure all automated production test racks remain fully operational, properly calibrated, and ready for use by production technicians. Daily responsibilities include planning and coordinating preventive maintenance with schedulers, organizing and tracking all rack calibration activities, and maintaining accurate documentation and hardware configuration data in partnership with supporting engineering teams.

This role also oversees the readiness of spare test racks, ensuring they are maintained, functional, and available for rapid swap-in when needed. It includes coordinating any required repairs to return equipment to operational status. Additional responsibilities include cataloging test harness requirements, monitoring inventory and life-usage of harnesses, and ensuring adequate spare coverage.

The engineer is expected to respond quickly to escalations from technicians, providing troubleshooting support and resolving operational issues with the test racks to minimize production downtime.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- 2+ years of experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging automated test systems including electrical, mechanical, electronic, networking, and software systems
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field and/or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of production test station (automated test equipment) hardware/software design and factory deployment
- 2+ years of experience with electrical test equipment, data acquisition, and control software
- Experience writing/reading/debugging software in Python, C, C# or other language

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of hardware design, development, validation and delivery of embedded hardware product experience
- 2+ years of experience with environmental testing focusing on thermal and vacuum test processes
- 2+ years of experience working with RF test systems

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Senior Engagement Manager (EM) to join our team and lead the delivery of complex cloud solution projects. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:
• Leading and managing complex cloud migration and implementation projects

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
- 2+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

- AWS experience preferred

title: サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は、岐阜県にある多治見FC（フルフィルメントセンター）になります。

Amazonの入荷・出荷のプロセスを行うFCには、世界最先端の自動化物流設備が導入されています。コンベア、ロボット、自動仕分けシステムなど、最新テクノロジーを活用し、商品の入出荷を効率的に行っています。このような先進的な環境で、次世代の物流技術に携わることができます。
　
RME（Reliability and Maintenance Engineering）部門は、日々物流設備の保全と保守、改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めております。 今回、RME部門が募集する職種はFCに導入されている物流設備の保全と保守、および設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただく「サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン」というポジションになります。
　
本ポジションは物流設備の保全経験者だけでなく、異業界・異職種からのキャリアチェンジをお考えの方も広く募集しています。これまでのエンジニアとしての経験を活かしながら、次のステージへと成長できる環境をご用意しております。入社後は体系的な教育プログラムに加え、豊富な経験を持つ先輩社員によるさぽーとにより、確かな技術力と自信を着実に身につけていただけます。
　
RMEにて技術力と現場感を身に着けることで将来的なキャリア選択肢は大きく広がります。マネジメント職や技術スペシャリストへのキャリアアップはもちろん、社内公募制度を通じて設備導入、設計、開発など、幅広いフィールドでの活躍も可能です。
　
【More Information】
■メンテナンス部門について
　・メンテナンスエンジニア特設サイト
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員T.S.さん
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員E.M.さん
■勤務地について
　・フルフィルメントセンター (FC)
　・勤務地:多治見FC
　
Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
下記業務をチームで対応いただきます。
■60%：日常点検・異常対応…稼働監視/巡回による設備点検/異常対応、故障復旧/オーバーホール、部品修繕
■20%：メンテナンス業務…予防保全/定期保全/状態保全/事後保全
■10%：安全対策…設備・作業環境の安全対策/5S活動
■5%：カイゼン活動…機械、電気、制御（PLC）と広い範囲でカイゼンや改造を実施
■5%：その他…メンテナンス計画/デザインレビュー
　
【取り扱う設備の一例（FCによって異なる）】
■Amazon Robotics（商品棚を持ち上げて移動させるロボット）
■荷合わせシステム（同じお客様が注文された商品を一つにまとめる設備）
■パッキング設備（荷合わせした商品をまとめて梱包する設備）
■仕分け設備（宛先ラベルの印刷と貼り付けを行い、配送方面毎に仕分けを行う設備）

A day in the life
【教育・研修】
・入社後は、体系化された教育プログラムに沿って、安全ルール、保全作業、専門的な技術習得（機械・電気・制御）を進めていただきます。同時に所属拠点ではOJTを通して実務を習得いただきます。まずは物流設備の軽微なエラー対応や保全・保守の補佐業務を担当いただき、バディー制度により先輩社員がサポートをいたしますので、不明点の確認や相談がしやすい環境となります。その後は今までのキャリアの中で培ってきたスキルを応用し、改善や安全対策、効率化施策を手掛けることで幅広い領域で活かしていただくことができます。
　
【働き方】
本ポジションは、シフト勤務になり「3交代・早番専属・夜勤専属」のシフトパターンがあります。
シフトパターンは希望を考慮の上、決定させていただきますが、将来的なシフト勤務形態の変更の可能性もございます。

退勤時間には次の班が出勤し引継ぎを行う為、残業時間が少なく、急な呼び出しも発生しません。
公共交通機関が運行しない時間帯でも交代勤務に出社できるようお願いいたします。
（自家用車・自転車は可（入社前に要申請・許可制）、バイク・タクシーは不可）

Basic qualifications

- 機械や電気機器の保全や保守、または生産技術・設備導入や立ち上げを1年以上ご経験された方
- PCを使用した作業のご経験のある方。（エクセル、ワード、Outlook）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（メールの読み書き、報告、連絡、相談ができる）

Preferred qualifications

- 機械部品の取扱経験・知識（モーター・エアシリンダー・動力伝達機構・バルブなど）

- 機械工学、もしくは電気工学の基礎知識 （工業高校または専門学校卒業程度）

descriptionHtml:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is looking for an Infrastructure Delivery Installation Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.
To be successful in this role you should possess technical aptitude, written and oral communications skills and the ability to deal effectively with people in a wide variety of situations. In addition, you must possess strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability. You will be able to leverage your experience exercising high levels of initiative, judgment, and diplomacy.

Additionally, all candidates should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

Physical Requirements:
All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role

Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment

title: Associate Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
This is not your typical entry-level sales role — it's a launchpad.

At Amazon, our peculiar culture and obsession with delighting customers extends to everything we do, including what we call our teams. While the industry knows this role as a SDR, BDR, Associate Account Executive, Amazon's customer-first DNA means we call our team members "Customer Acquisition Representatives" (CARs). It's more than a name, it reflects our belief that every interaction should start and end with the customer. As a CAR, you'll accelerate pipeline growth, navigate complex customer landscapes, shift gears between strategic thinking and high-impact execution, and put customers in the driver's seat of their cloud journey. Every CAR needs fuel, yours will be curiosity, coaching, and the full support of the world's leading cloud platform.

As a CAR, you will take the lead in unlocking growth potential for both new and existing AWS customers. We are one of the principal sources of new pipeline that fuels the AWS engine – engaging the unengaged accounts and contacts to drive pipeline that turns into revenue. Using cutting-edge AI tools and data-driven insights, you'll identify whitespace opportunities and develop innovative strategies to reach unengaged accounts at scale. You'll be part of shaping how technology is deployed across thousands of organizations, from enabling rapid, individually customized cancer treatments to helping Fortune 500 companies meet their carbon emissions goals. The AWS technology stack is the backbone of some of the most innovative solutions to the world's most pressing problems.

Your career path is clear. This role is designed as the entry point into AWS's North American sales organization. We don't need the perfect candidate, but we do want people who are curious, coachable, and willing to learn. We've developed hundreds of early-career professionals into full cycle sellers as Cloud Sales Representatives (CSRs), many within 18–24 months. You'll be paired with mentors and have access to structured development programs that accelerate your growth from day one.

According to Gartner, AWS is the leading cloud provider in both ability to execute and completeness of vision. With only 5% of all IT spend in the cloud, we are still in the early stages of what is possible, and with the explosion of generative AI, the opportunity has never been larger. You'll be at the forefront, equipped with the most advanced AI-powered sales technology in the industry. Consider this your pit crew advantage — the tools, training, and teammates that keep you performing at your best.


Key job responsibilities
•Partner closely with Account Teams to develop a deep understanding of the primary industries, accounts, and personas within your territories — building relationships from technical admins to Line of Business executives.
•Lead top-of-funnel activity: conduct high-quality account research and source net-new contacts at scale to execute high-volume prospecting, lead qualification, and opportunity generation across your assigned territories.
•Drive net-new business via customer acquisition by leveraging one-to-one and one-to-many outbound campaigns, in addition to qualifying leads from marketing and partner channels.
•Expand services breadth and consumption within your existing customer base via account planning and territory management.
•Deliver results against input and output goals, including: contacts sourced, leads qualified, customer calls completed, meetings scheduled, and opportunities created and launched.
•Leverage AI-powered sales intelligence platforms, predictive analytics, and automation tools to identify high-propensity accounts, prioritize outreach, and optimize pipeline development in Salesforce.
•Stay ahead of the curve with next-generation engagement strategies using generative AI, agentic workflows, and advanced personalization engines — you'll be on the cutting edge of how AI transforms B2B sales, continuously testing and iterating on new approaches to reach unengaged accounts.
•Collaborate with teammates to share best practices, contribute to team learning, and collectively raise the bar for customer engagement.

We know great candidates don't always check every box. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match, we encourage you to apply.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 1+ year(s) of experience in sales, business development, lead generation, or customer-facing roles (internships and non-traditional experience count)

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of experience in technology sales, SaaS, or cloud services
- Experience with outbound prospecting tools and techniques (cold calling, social selling, email sequencing)
- Experience leveraging or interest in leveraging AI tools to enhance sales workflows, research, and outreach
